## Problem

Who is affected, on which OPNsense and FreeBSD package ABI?

## Proposed change

Describe the package, service binary, FreeBSD port, dependencies, licensing, and
why the package belongs in this unsupported community repository.

## Source and build provenance

Link the source and FreeBSD port where applicable. Explain how a package is
reproducibly built. Precompiled binaries are not accepted without an explicit
maintainer exception and provenance.

## Compatibility

Describe clean-install and upgrade expectations, configuration migrations,
conflicts with existing packages, and test evidence.

## Tooling disclosure

List AI or automated tools and models used to prepare the proposal, or write
"none".
